repairs.before: Why it matters: today the links between obligation, control, FenX capability, test, evidence and owner are often implicit — scattered across Jira, FenX configuration, test artefacts, SharePoint, spreadsheets and people's knowledge. Which requirements changed but were never retested? Which gaps lack a named owner?
repairs.after: Explicit links support coverage and change-review questions: which obligations lack a mapped control, which requirements lack test evidence, and which changes need reassessment? Links alone do not establish continuous assurance; valid evidence, actual controls and their maintained scope are still required.

repairs.after: A later assistant may reuse maintained knowledge and methods when they fit its purpose and permitted consumption. Reuse is conditional; lower cost, greater safety and better outcomes require evidence.
